# SEO-584: Avoid emitting duplicate or conflicting preview properties

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Domain | `social-preview` |
| Category | `SEARCH_DISCOVERABILITY` |
| Minimum level | `RECOMMENDED` |
| Severity | `MEDIUM` |
| Impact | `LOW` |
| Change safety | `SAFE_AUTOMATIC` |
| Evidence tier | `A` |
| Confidence | `HIGH` |

## Statement

Each preview property appears once per response, except where the specification defines the property as repeatable, and a layout default does not survive alongside a page-level override of the same property.

## Rationale

When one property appears twice, which value a platform reads is its own decision, so the site can supply the right value and still show the wrong preview.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Merge the layout defaults and the page values in one place before rendering, keying by property name so an override replaces rather than joins the default. Remove any plugin emitting a second copy instead of leaving both.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Count occurrences of each preview property in the served response and report any non-repeatable property appearing more than once.
- Evidence: `RENDERED_HTML`, `RAW_HTML`, `ROUTE`
- Automated check: `og-duplicate-properties`

## Scope

- Search surfaces: `SOCIAL_PREVIEW`
- Frameworks: `any`
- Caution: none recorded.
